title: Agent Whitelist Framework: criteria document
description: One version of the rules a list applies. Its keccak256 over the RFC 8785 form is Criteria.documentHash

dimensions.description: The dimensions the rule looks at. Empty for a list that rests on designation alone

evaluation.description: PREDICATE: how the rule is computed

evidenceFormat.description: What the requester presents, as an ABI type or a description

parameters.description: The values the evaluator is configured with; they are covered by its configHash

extension.description: DERIVED with a relation: which objects related to a listed one the list reaches

direction.description: From the listed object to the object reached

evidence.description: What establishes the relation, and by whose acts

time.description: When the relation has to hold
